query:
WITH FilteredDeaths AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        death_date,
        birth_date,
        gender,
        nationality,
        marital_status
    FROM estishraf_llm_demographics_impala
    WHERE death_date IS NOT NULL
      AND death_date BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2017-12-31'
),
AgeRanges AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        YEAR(death_date) AS death_year,
        CASE
            WHEN YEAR(death_date) - YEAR(birth_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 10  THEN '0-10'
            WHEN YEAR(death_date) - YEAR(birth_date) BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN '11-20'
            WHEN YEAR(death_date) - YEAR(birth_date) BETWEEN 21 AND 40 THEN '21-40'
            WHEN YEAR(death_date) - YEAR(birth_date) BETWEEN 41 AND 60 THEN '41-60'
            ELSE '61+'
        END AS age_range,
        gender,
        nationality,
        marital_status
    FROM FilteredDeaths
),
MaritalStatusGroups AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        death_year,
        age_range,
        gender,
        nationality,
        CASE
            WHEN marital_status IN ('زوجة واحدة', 'زوجتين', 'متزوج', 'متزوجة') THEN 'Married'
            WHEN marital_status IN ('غير متزوجة', 'اعزب') THEN 'Single'
            WHEN marital_status IN ('مطلق', 'مطلقة', 'منفصل', 'منفصلة') THEN 'Divorced'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS marital_status_group
    FROM AgeRanges
)
SELECT
    death_year,
    age_range,
    gender,
    nationality,
    marital_status_group,
    COUNT(*) AS death_count
FROM MaritalStatusGroups
GROUP BY
    death_year,
    age_range,
    gender,
    nationality,
    marital_status_group
ORDER BY
    death_count DESC LIMIT 1200
